name: eden-iss-antarctica-biomass-production
title: Biomass Production of the EDEN ISS Space Greenhouse in Antarctica During the 2018 Experiment Phase
description: FAIR dataset documenting biomass yields, growth cycles, environmental set points, and nutrient solutions for 19 crop cohorts cultivated in the EDEN ISS Future Exploration Greenhouse (FEG) in Antarctica. Derived from NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) study OSD-895 and published in Frontiers in Plant Science (PMC7264257).
